user_motivation: Confirmed working motivation: the representation at an enforcement boundary induces equivalence classes over tool executions and therefore upper-bounds the distinctions available to every downstream authorization policy. The paper makes this authorization-observability obligation explicit and validates candidate interfaces through source-executed effect witnesses, independent policy-separating witnesses, and representation collisions. Typed effect atoms are one candidate interface; the narrow deterministic provenance-origin mediator is a separate integration case, not a complete ACL, delegation, quota, or general authority-envelope system.
special_requirements: Treat E47--E50 and source-executed collision audits as problem and representation evidence; use E55-v2 only as historical controlled feasibility evidence.
Disclose that the current AgentDojo registry retains 67/67 fields and that field roles are lexical audit annotations rather than independently validated semantics.
Use C1f only as a bounded provenance-origin mediation case study; do not describe it as complete task authority, ACL, delegation, or quota enforcement.
Keep the technical body within 13 pages under the official USENIX template; references and appendices are excluded.
Include an Open Science Appendix and an anonymous reproducible artifact.
Every number must carry sample size or numerator/denominator and source artifact/key path where available.
Do not claim production safety, original-paper benchmark reproduction, unconditional complete mediation, or guarantees beyond tested contract and TCB assumptions.
